_comment: Twelve questions over the five Northwind policy versions, covering every temporal intent the system implements: current, point_in_time, range, version, historical. Kept deliberately small — each question costs three LLM calls per run (analyzer, answer, judge) on a free Groq key. `type` is the intent the question is expected to be read as; `supporting_versions` is the version(s) whose text contains the reference answer.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave do Northwind employees get per year?
questions.answer: 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
What is the notice period for resignation after probation?
How many days of annual leave were employees entitled to on 2022-06-15?
questions.answer: 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: What was the notice period for resignation on 2024-03-15?
How many weeks of paid parental leave did the company provide during 2023?
What was the maximum business travel expense a manager could approve per trip during 2022?
According to version 2.0 of the policy, how many days per week could employees work remotely?
According to version 4.0 of the policy, how many weeks of paid parental leave were provided?
What was the annual leave entitlement in version 1.0 of the policy?
questions.answer: 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How many days per week could employees work remotely when the policy was first issued?
What was the earliest health insurance sum insured the company offered?
